chart_check.reason: Overall equivalence is fair. While most text elements like the axis title and annotations are identical, the y-axis tick labels have been changed from 'shot #1', 'shot #2', etc., to 'sample 1', 'sample 2', etc. In a scientific context, 'shot' (referring to a measurement event) and 'sample' (referring to a specimen) have distinct meanings, so this change alters important details and loses accuracy.
